sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: For decades, drug companies have argued that patents are critical to bringing new drugs to market.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，制药公司一直辩称，专利对于将新药推向市场至关重要。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Rebecca Robbins, on a case that suggests they can also create perverse incentives to hold new drugs back.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事丽贝卡·罗宾斯将讲述一个案例，该案例表明专利也可能产生反向激励，从而阻碍新药的推出。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, September 7th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月7日，星期四。

sentences.en: So Rebecca, you report on the pharmaceutical industry and you've been reporting on a case involving a big name American drug company.
sentences.zh: 那么丽贝卡，你负责报道制药行业，而且你一直在跟进一家美国大型知名制药公司的案件。

sentences.en: Tell me about that reporting.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说你的报道吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 好的，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: So we all know that prices are really high for many drugs in the United States.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道，美国许多药物的价格确实非常高。

sentences.en: And in some respects, that is by design.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，这是有意为之的。

sentences.en: So the way the system works is we rely on for-profit companies to spend a lot of money to develop and bring to market new drugs.
sentences.zh: 这个系统的运作方式是，我们依赖营利性公司投入大量资金来开发新药并将其推向市场。

sentences.en: And in return for spending that money for taking all those risks, they get to have a monopoly that lasts for years.
sentences.zh: 作为投入资金和承担所有风险的回报，他们可以获得长达数年的垄断权。

sentences.en: And that allows them to sell their medications for lots of money and keep those prices high.
sentences.zh: 这使他们能够以高价出售药物，并保持高昂的价格。

sentences.en: And there are actually laws and regulations that protect that monopoly.
sentences.zh: 实际上，确实有法律和法规在保护这种垄断。

sentences.en: And part of the rationale for this system is that the promise of these profits creates incentives for the company to produce new and better drugs to help more people.
sentences.zh: 该系统背后的部分逻辑是，利润前景能激励公司生产更好、更新的药物来帮助更多人。

sentences.en: But recently, my colleague Cheryl Gay-Stilberg and I came across a case that I think raises serious questions about whether the system is always getting the best medications
sentences.zh: 但最近，我和我的同事谢丽尔·盖伊-斯蒂尔伯格发现了一个案例，我认为这引发了严重的质疑：该系统是否总是能尽快地
zh_words: 谢丽尔·盖伊-斯蒂尔伯格

sentences.en: to patients as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 将最好的药物提供给患者。

sentences.en: And where does that story start?
sentences.zh: 这个故事是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: So I want to start with the story of a patient named David Swisher.
sentences.zh: 我想从一位名叫大卫·斯威舍的患者的故事开始讲起。

sentences.en: Hi, Rebecca.
sentences.zh: 你好，丽贝卡。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your- So today, David is a 66-year-old retiree.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你——大卫今年66岁，已经退休了。

sentences.en: He's living in Florida after retiring from a long career in the airline industry that took him all over the country for different jobs.
sentences.zh: 他在航空业工作了很长时间，这份工作让他为了不同的任务跑遍了全国，退休后他住在佛罗里达州。

sentences.en: And so back in 1997- I was living in Texas, south of Houston, and I just turned 40.
sentences.zh: 回到1997年，当时我住在德克萨斯州，休斯顿南部，我刚满40岁。

sentences.en: David started feeling ill.
sentences.zh: 大卫开始感到不适。

sentences.en: And it was very intense.
sentences.zh: 而且感觉非常强烈。

sentences.en: I mean, it was like, you're aching from head to toe.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就像全身都在酸痛。

sentences.en: I kept going into the emergency room, like for a week, telling him, I feel bad.
sentences.zh: 我连续一周不停地去急诊室，告诉医生我感觉很不舒服。

sentences.en: Something's wrong.
sentences.zh: 肯定有什么不对劲。

sentences.en: I have the flu.
sentences.zh: 我得了流感。

sentences.en: After the third time I went in there, really, really not feeling good, someone was smart enough to send me upstairs and say, let's do a workover on this guy, see what's going on.
sentences.zh: 第三次去的时候，我真的感觉非常糟糕，有人足够聪明，把我送到了楼上，说：给这家伙做个全面检查，看看是怎么回事。

sentences.en: And finally, after two nights in the hospital, one of the young interns, she came in and she just says, well, we figured out what's wrong with you.
sentences.zh: 最后，在医院住了两晚后，一位年轻的实习医生走进来，她说：好吧，我们查出你得了什么病了。

sentences.en: It turned out that he had HIV.
sentences.zh: 结果他患上了艾滋病。

sentences.en: What was going through your head at that moment?
sentences.zh: 那一刻你脑子里在想什么？

sentences.en: That I was going to drop dead.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我快要死了。

sentences.en: And when he got his diagnosis, his mind immediately turned to his worst fears.
sentences.zh: 当他拿到诊断结果时，他的脑海里立刻浮现出他最恐惧的事情。

sentences.en: I'd lived through all that epidemic from, I lived in San Francisco from 1978 until 1984.
sentences.zh: 我经历了那场流行病，从1978年到1984年我一直住在旧金山。

sentences.en: And it just got so gloomy and dark.
sentences.zh: 当时气氛变得非常阴郁和黑暗。

sentences.en: He had a huge number of friends that he loSt.
sentences.zh: 他失去了很多朋友。

sentences.en: It was a really, really painful time.
sentences.zh: 那是一段非常、非常痛苦的时光。

sentences.en: Like 80% of my friends had died in a six-year period, and all of them were under 30.
sentences.zh: 六年间，我大约80%的朋友都去世了，而且他们都不到30岁。

sentences.en: It just, they'd call me on Friday and say,
sentences.zh: 他们会在周五打电话给我说：

sentences.en: David, I parked my car, you know, in a bad spot, and I left the keys in your desk.
sentences.zh: 大卫，我把车停在一个不好的位置，钥匙放在你桌子上了。

sentences.en: Can you move my car so I can, you know, it doesn't get towed away?
sentences.zh: 你能帮我挪一下车吗，这样它就不会被拖走？

sentences.en: And then bringing it up to me in the hospital on Monday.
sentences.zh: 然后周一我在医院里提起这件事。

sentences.en: Okay, so no problem.
sentences.zh: 好吧，没问题。

sentences.en: I'd go move their vehicle, go up on Sunday night to see them and find out they were dead.
sentences.zh: 我会去挪他们的车，周日晚上去医院看他们时，却发现他们已经去世了。

sentences.en: So when David got his HIV diagnosis in the mid-1990s, he thought it was a death sentence.
sentences.zh: 所以当大卫在90年代中期被诊断出患有艾滋病时，他认为这等于被判了死刑。

sentences.en: But it turns out it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明并非如此。

sentences.en: And that's because by that point, drug companies were making huge strides in treating HIV with powerful new medications.
sentences.zh: 这是因为到那时，制药公司在用强效新药治疗艾滋病方面取得了巨大进展。

sentences.en: But the first versions of these drugs had some really tough side effects.
sentences.zh: 但这些药物的早期版本有一些非常严重的副作用。

sentences.en: They were really challenging for patients to take.
sentences.zh: 患者服用起来非常困难。

sentences.en: In my mind, I'm thinking, that's fine.
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，没关系。

sentences.en: I'll be alive.
sentences.zh: 只要能活着就行。

sentences.en: You know, I'd much rather be alive than the option, which wasn't good.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我宁愿活着，也不愿选择另一种结果，因为那并不好。

sentences.en: But I was allowed to go back to work, and I was pretty much, you know, I'd lost some weight.
sentences.zh: 但我获准回去工作了，我基本上，你知道，瘦了一些。

sentences.en: And I didn't look really healthy, but I was able to regain the weight and continue.
sentences.zh: 我看起来不太健康，但我能够恢复体重并继续生活。

sentences.en: But over time, the medications became easier to take, fewer side effects, more convenient.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，药物变得更容易服用，副作用更少，也更方便了。

sentences.en: It went from a cocktail of a bunch of pills to one pill a day.
sentences.zh: 从一大把药丸的鸡尾酒疗法变成了每天一片药。

sentences.en: And in 2004, a drug company called Gilead released a drug called Truvada.
sentences.zh: 2004年，一家名为吉利德的制药公司发布了一种名为舒发泰（Truvada）的药物。

sentences.en: You may have heard of it.
sentences.zh: 你可能听说过它。

sentences.en: Today, it's used for both preventing HIV and treating it.
sentences.zh: 今天，它既用于预防艾滋病，也用于治疗艾滋病。

sentences.en: I remember it was a big deal when it came out.
sentences.zh: 我记得它刚出来的时候引起了很大轰动。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It was a huge deal.
sentences.zh: 那是一件大事。

sentences.en: And that's because it was really effective.
sentences.zh: 因为它非常有效。

sentences.en: Many patients had less severe side effects on Truvada, and it was more convenient to take.
sentences.zh: 许多患者服用舒发泰后的副作用较轻，而且服用更方便。

sentences.en: It really became a game-changer in the fight against AIDS.
sentences.zh: 它确实成为了抗击艾滋病过程中的一个转折点。

sentences.en: And the key ingredient in Truvada is a version of something called tenofovir.
sentences.zh: 舒发泰的关键成分是一种名为替诺福韦的物质。

sentences.en: It prevents the HIV virus from replicating.
sentences.zh: 它可以防止艾滋病毒复制。

sentences.en: This doctor said to me, he says, well, you're doing well on the three medications you're on, but the drug rep has really been pushing this,
sentences.zh: 医生对我说，你现在服用的三种药物效果不错，但医药代表一直在推销这个，

sentences.en: touting it really as a miracle medication.
sentences.zh: 把它吹捧为一种神奇的药物。

sentences.en: It's all about convenience.
sentences.zh: 一切都是为了方便。

sentences.en: It's one pill.
sentences.zh: 只需要一片药。

sentences.en: All you got to do is take one pill.
sentences.zh: 你所要做的就是吃一片药。

sentences.en: So I started taking the Truvada.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始服用舒发泰。

sentences.en: That's where it started.
sentences.zh: 一切就是从那里开始的。

sentences.en: So David did well on this pill for a while, but then something started to change for him.
sentences.zh: 大卫服用这种药一段时间后效果不错，但后来他开始感觉到一些变化。

sentences.en: He felt different.
sentences.zh: 他感觉不一样了。

sentences.en: I would say between 2006 and 2011,
sentences.zh: 我想在2006年到2011年之间，

sentences.en: it had gotten progressively worse.
sentences.zh: 情况逐渐恶化了。

sentences.en: Just really achy, like achy inside my bones.
sentences.zh: 就是感觉非常酸痛，就像骨头里面在痛一样。

sentences.en: And just really like someone to kind of beat me up, you know.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像有人把我打了一顿，你知道。

sentences.en: Just achy all over.
sentences.zh: 全身都酸痛。

sentences.en: And so after a long time trying to figure out what was going on,
sentences.zh: 在尝试弄清楚发生了什么很长一段时间后，

sentences.en: David's primary care doctor had an idea.
sentences.zh: 大卫的家庭医生想到了一个主意。

sentences.en: He suggested ordering a scan of David's bones.
sentences.zh: 他建议给大卫的骨骼做一次扫描。

sentences.en: Okay, so we did it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们做了检查。

sentences.en: And so I sat there and he came in and he says, well, it's like bones of a 90-year-old woman.
sentences.zh: 我坐在那里，医生走进来，他说：好吧，这看起来像是一个90岁老妇人的骨头。

sentences.en: I've never seen anyone at your age have such severe osteoporosis.
sentences.zh: 我从来没见过像你这个年纪的人患有如此严重的骨质疏松症。

sentences.en: So at this point, your man who's 62 being told you have the bones of a 90-year-old, how did it feel to hear that?
sentences.zh: 那么，作为一个62岁的人，被告知拥有90岁老人的骨头，听到这些是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Frightening.
sentences.zh: 很可怕。

sentences.en: All that the primary care said was,
sentences.zh: 家庭医生只说了：

sentences.en: it's quite possible that it's toxicity from some of the medications that you may be taking.
sentences.zh: 这很有可能是你正在服用的一些药物产生的毒性。

sentences.en: The conclusion he and his doctors came to was that even though Truvado was treating David's HIV and keeping him alive,
sentences.zh: 他和医生得出的结论是，尽管舒发泰在治疗大卫的艾滋病并维持他的生命，

sentences.en: it also appeared to be the most likely cause of the side effects, the weakness in his bones, and also some kidney issues he was experiencing.
sentences.zh: 但它似乎也是导致副作用的最可能原因，包括骨骼脆弱，以及他正在经历的一些肾脏问题。

sentences.en: So what does he do?
sentences.zh: 那么他该怎么办？

sentences.en: Well, fortunately for David, in 2016, Gilead released a new HIV drug.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，2016年，吉利德发布了一种新的艾滋病药物。

sentences.en: This new drug contained a newer version of tenofovir.
sentences.zh: 这种新药含有更新版本的替诺福韦。

sentences.en: Again, that's the active ingredient in Truvada, the medication that appeared to be making David sick.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这就是舒发泰的活性成分，也就是那种似乎让大卫生病的药物。

sentences.en: But this new formulation of tenofovir was different.
sentences.zh: 但这种替诺福韦的新配方有所不同。

sentences.en: The tweak in the formulation of tenofovir turned out to be a big deal.
sentences.zh: 替诺福韦配方的改进结果证明意义重大。

sentences.en: It ended up meaning that the medication didn't carry the same side effects that David had been experiencing.
sentences.zh: 它最终意味着这种药物不会产生大卫之前经历过的那些副作用。

sentences.en: So David switched over to Gilead's newer version of the drug, and his health began to improve.
sentences.zh: 于是大卫换成了吉利德的新版药物，他的健康状况开始好转。

sentences.en: But David had spent years suffering from side effects he attributes to Truvada.
sentences.zh: 但大卫已经忍受了多年他认为是由舒发泰引起的副作用。

sentences.en: He even took an early retirement because he felt he wasn't able to work anymore.
sentences.zh: 他甚至提前退休了，因为他觉得无法再继续工作。

sentences.en: So he wanted to know what exactly had gone wrong with Truvada.
sentences.zh: 所以他想知道舒发泰到底出了什么问题。

sentences.en: So I googled kidney decline and severe osteoporosis.
sentences.zh: 于是我搜索了肾功能衰退和严重骨质疏松症。

sentences.en: David did some googling, and he came across an advertisement from lawyers who were looking for patients, patients who had experienced side effects like the ones he had.
sentences.zh: 大卫搜索了一下，看到了一则律师广告，他们在寻找像他一样经历过副作用的患者。

sentences.en: These lawyers were suing Gilead, and David was eligible to join the lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 这些律师正在起诉吉利德，大卫有资格加入诉讼。

sentences.en: And I thought about it, you know, really reluctantly.
sentences.zh: 我考虑了一下，你知道，真的很不情愿。

sentences.en: I had never seen anybody, so I was thinking,
sentences.zh: 我从来没见过这种事，所以我心想，

sentences.en: first of all, I wouldn't really know how to go about it.
sentences.zh: 首先，我真的不知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: And is that something that I wanted to get into, you know, or did I just want to let the medicines do their work?
sentences.zh: 这是我想要卷入的事情吗，还是我只想让药物发挥作用就好？

sentences.en: David was reluctant at first to reach out to these lawyers.
sentences.zh: 大卫起初不愿联系这些律师。

sentences.en: He was taking the new drug.
sentences.zh: 他当时正在服用新药。

sentences.en: It seemed to be working much better for him.
sentences.zh: 它对他来说效果似乎好多了。

sentences.en: But it just really got me mad.
sentences.zh: 但这真的让我很生气。

sentences.en: But he was also angry that Truvada, this drug he'd taken for years and years, appeared to have hurt him so much.
sentences.zh: 但他也很愤怒，因为舒发泰这种他服用了很多年的药物，似乎对他造成了如此大的伤害。

sentences.en: And he was also angry at Gilead.
sentences.zh: 他也对吉利德感到愤怒。

sentences.en: So David ultimately decided to join the lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 所以大卫最终决定加入诉讼。

sentences.en: He became one of some 26,000 patients who were suing Gilead.
sentences.zh: 他成为了起诉吉利德的约26,000名患者之一。

sentences.en: And what are they arguing in the lawsuit?
sentences.zh: 他们在诉讼中提出了什么论点？

sentences.en: Like, on what grounds are they suing Gilead?
sentences.zh: 他们是以什么理由起诉吉利德的？

sentences.en: Lawyers for these patients have put together a number of claiMs.
sentences.zh: 这些患者的律师整理出了一系列指控。

sentences.en: They're arguing the usual sorts of things you see in personal injury lawsuits,
sentences.zh: 他们提出的都是人身伤害诉讼中常见的那些理由，

sentences.en: that Gilead was aware of the problems and did not adequately warn patients about these potential side effects.
sentences.zh: 即吉利德早就知道这些问题，但没有充分警告患者这些潜在的副作用。

sentences.en: But they're also making a more unusual claim.
sentences.zh: 但他们也提出了一个比较不同寻常的指控。

sentences.en: They say that the newer version of tenofovir, that's the one David eventually switched over to, that didn't have the same bone and kidney side effects,
sentences.zh: 他们说，更新版本的替诺福韦——也就是大卫最终换用的那种没有相同骨骼和肾脏副作用的药物——

sentences.en: could have been made available to patients about a decade earlier than it was.
sentences.zh: 本可以在大约十年前就提供给患者。

sentences.en: So what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？

sentences.en: There was a newer version that's better and they just held it?
sentences.zh: 有一种更好更新的版本，而他们只是扣着没发？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They say that Gilead had been working on this newer version in the early 2000s.
sentences.zh: 他们说吉利德在21世纪初就已经在研发这个更新版本了。

sentences.en: They also claim that even though there was good reason at the time to think that the newer version would turn out to be safer,
sentences.zh: 他们还声称，尽管当时有充分的理由认为更新版本会更安全，

sentences.en: that it wouldn't have those same kidney and bone side effects,
sentences.zh: 即它不会有同样的肾脏和骨骼副作用，

sentences.en: Gilead still decided to delay bringing it to market.
sentences.zh: 吉利德公司最终还是决定推迟将该药推向市场。

sentences.en: So they're arguing that the company actually had a newer version that was safer, that they withheld.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的论点是，该公司其实已经研发出了一种更安全的新版本，但却将其扣留了。

sentences.en: But why would they do that?
sentences.zh: 但他们为什么要这么做呢？

sentences.en: Well, the theory is that it was all about maximizing profits.
sentences.zh: 嗯，理论上讲，这一切都是为了利润最大化。

sentences.en: Okay, so explain what you mean by that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，解释一下你这话的意思。

sentences.en: Well, it all goes back to this system that I was talking about, this for-profit system of drug development.
sentences.zh: 这要追溯到我刚才提到的那个体系，即以营利为目的的药物研发体系。

sentences.en: A central part of that is patents, which protect a drug company's intellectual property.
sentences.zh: 该体系的核心部分是专利，它保护着制药公司的知识产权。

sentences.en: Patents are really the lifeblood of the pharmaceutical industry.
sentences.zh: 专利确实是制药行业的命脉。

sentences.en: So the way it works is when a drug company develops a product, they can and do file for lots of patents.
sentences.zh: 其运作方式是，当一家制药公司开发出一款产品时，他们可以并且确实会申请大量专利。

sentences.en: And together, these patents create a monopoly which lasts for years.
sentences.zh: 这些专利共同构成了一个持续多年的垄断地位。

sentences.en: That means other companies cannot sell a generic version of the same drug.
sentences.zh: 这意味着其他公司无法销售同类药物的仿制版本。

sentences.en: And so prices stay high because whichever company controls the patents faces no competition.
sentences.zh: 因此价格居高不下，因为任何控制专利的公司都不会面临竞争。

sentences.en: And what's the rationale for that?
sentences.zh: 那么，这样做的理由是什么呢？

sentences.en: The thinking is, if you were to do all this research and spend all this money to bring a drug to market, and then immediately your competitors could just come in
sentences.zh: 人们认为，如果你投入了所有的研究并花费了巨额资金将一种药物推向市场，而竞争对手却能立即介入，

sentences.en: and sell knockoff copies of your hard work so you couldn't make money, well, then you wouldn't have much of an incentive to do that innovation in the first place.
sentences.zh: 销售你辛苦研发成果的廉价仿制品，让你无法盈利，那么你最初就不会有太大的动力去进行创新。

sentences.en: And I think there's broad agreement that a lot of times that system works really well.
sentences.zh: 我认为大家普遍认同，在很多情况下，这个体系运作得非常好。

sentences.en: But critics say there are also downsides to this system.
sentences.zh: 但批评人士指出，这个体系也存在弊端。

sentences.en: For one, it keeps drug prices higher for longer.
sentences.zh: 首先，它让药价在更长时间内保持高位。

sentences.en: And in David's case, his lawyers are arguing that the system created an incentive for Gilead to delay bringing its innovation to the market.
sentences.zh: 就大卫的案例而言，他的律师认为，该体系激励了吉利德公司推迟将其创新成果推向市场。

sentences.en: That was the newer drug that would have been safer for David.
sentences.zh: 那就是对大卫来说更安全的新型药物。

sentences.en: So Gilead had a monopoly on the older version of the drug.
sentences.zh: 所以，吉利德公司对旧版药物拥有垄断权。

sentences.en: That's the one that was in the medication that David took.
sentences.zh: 也就是大卫服用的那种药物。

sentences.en: And that monopoly was due to expire in 2017.
sentences.zh: 而该垄断权原定于2017年到期。

sentences.en: So that meant that Gilead had full protection against competition until then and could keep prices high.
sentences.zh: 这意味着吉利德公司在那之前拥有完全的竞争保护，可以维持高价。

sentences.en: And the plaintiff's lawyers argue that Gilead intentionally decided not to release the newer, potentially safer version of the drug so that it could make more money.
sentences.zh: 原告律师认为，吉利德公司故意决定不发布这种可能更安全的新版药物，以便赚取更多利润。

sentences.en: Okay, so the plaintiffs are saying that, you know, we've been suffering from these side effects, which you, Gilead, knew about.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以原告方是说，我们一直遭受这些副作用的折磨，而你们吉利德公司是知情的。

sentences.en: And all the while, you had a new drug that didn't have those side effects, but you didn't release it because you didn't want to effectively eat into the profit
sentences.zh: 与此同时，你们明明有一种没有这些副作用的新药，却不发布，因为你们不想实质性地蚕食

sentences.en: that the first drug was still bringing in.
sentences.zh: 第一种药物仍在带来的利润。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what did Gilead say?
sentences.zh: 那吉利德公司怎么说？

sentences.en: And what was their response about this allegation that they intentionally withheld the drug for profit?
sentences.zh: 对于他们为了利润故意扣留药物的指控，他们的回应是什么？

sentences.en: So Gilead denies the allegation completely.
sentences.zh: 吉利德公司完全否认了这一指控。

sentences.en: The company acknowledges that they did delay the drug's development.
sentences.zh: 该公司承认他们确实推迟了该药物的开发。

sentences.en: In fact, they publicly acknowledged in 2004, when they made the decision, they put out a press release announcing that they had decided to stop developing the drug.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们在2004年做出决定时就公开承认了这一点，并发布了一份新闻稿，宣布他们决定停止开发该药物。

sentences.en: But the company says that had nothing to do with profit.
sentences.zh: 但该公司表示，这与利润无关。

sentences.en: The real reason, they said at the time, and they say now, is that the newer version wasn't sufficiently different from the older version to justify moving it forward.
sentences.zh: 他们当时和现在都声称，真正的原因是新版本与旧版本相比差异不足，不足以证明继续推进的必要性。

sentences.en: And on its face, that's a completely reasonable reason to not move forward with a drug.
sentences.zh: 从表面上看，这确实是一个不继续开发某种药物的合理理由。

sentences.en: It doesn't make sense to bring to market two virtually identical versions of the same thing.
sentences.zh: 将两种几乎完全相同的东西推向市场是没有意义的。

sentences.en: But as this lawsuit has unfolded and moved through the court system,
sentences.zh: 但随着这起诉讼在法院系统的推进，

sentences.en: the lawyers for the patients who are suing have, as part of the normal discovery process,
sentences.zh: 起诉的患者律师作为正常取证程序的一部分，

sentences.en: managed to get their hands on internal company documents from around the time in the early 2000s,
sentences.zh: 设法获取了21世纪初左右的公司内部文件，

sentences.en: when Gilead executives were making decisions around the development for this newer version of the drug.
sentences.zh: 当时吉利德的高管们正在就该药物新版本的开发做出决策。

sentences.en: And those documents give a really rare view of what was going on behind the scenes, of what the company executives were considering.
sentences.zh: 这些文件提供了一个非常难得的视角，让我们得以窥见幕后发生的事情，以及公司高管们当时在考虑什么。

sentences.en: And I think they suggest that Gilead's version of events doesn't reflect the whole story.
sentences.zh: 我认为这些文件表明，吉利德对事件的描述并未反映出全部真相。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一个关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代去夜店当DJ的时候，每天晚上你都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个活生生的、展示精美50年历史文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: So, Rebecca, you told us that the plaintiffs in this case are arguing that
sentences.zh: 那么，丽贝卡，你告诉我们，本案的原告方认为，

sentences.en: Gilead withheld a safer drug from the market in order to maximize their profits.
sentences.zh: 吉利德公司为了利润最大化，将一种更安全的药物扣留，没有推向市场。

sentences.en: Gilead denies this.
sentences.zh: 吉利德对此予以否认。

sentences.en: But now, the plaintiff's lawyers have their hands on all of these internal documents.
sentences.zh: 但现在，原告律师掌握了所有这些内部文件。

sentences.en: So, what do we actually know about what happened here?
sentences.zh: 那么，关于这里发生的事情，我们到底了解多少？

sentences.en: So, the documents give us a really fascinating look inside this drug company at a time when executives were making decisions about these medications.
sentences.zh: 这些文件让我们得以深入了解这家制药公司，当时高管们正在对这些药物做出决策。

sentences.en: So, let's go back to the year 2001.
sentences.zh: 让我们回到2001年。

sentences.en: That was the year that the FDA approved the original version of tenofovir.
sentences.zh: 那是FDA批准最初版替诺福韦的一年。

sentences.en: And in those early years, the evidence began to accumulate that some patients, very small fraction of the overall number, but some patients, did develop side effects,
sentences.zh: 在最初的几年里，证据开始积累，显示一些患者——虽然只是总数中极小的一部分，但确实有一些患者——出现了副作用，

sentences.en: typically problems with their bones, their kidneys, that appear to be caused, at least in part, by the older version of tenofovir.
sentences.zh: 通常是骨骼和肾脏方面的问题，这些问题似乎至少部分是由旧版替诺福韦引起的。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: But Gilead was not just banking on the original formulation of this drug.
sentences.zh: 但吉利德并不只是依赖这种药物的原始配方。

sentences.en: Like companies typically do, Gilead scientists were tinkering in the lab with other very similar compounds.
sentences.zh: 像其他公司一样，吉利德的科学家们也在实验室里摆弄着其他非常相似的化合物。

sentences.en: The idea was that if you make small changes, tinker with molecules, you might find some dramatically improved drug or learn something important or have a backup in
sentences.zh: 他们的想法是，如果你做一些微小的改变，摆弄一下分子，你可能会发现某种大幅改进的药物，或者学到一些重要的东西，或者作为一种备份，

sentences.en: case the product that was being prioritized didn't pan out.
sentences.zh: 以防优先开发的产品最终失败。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And one of those molecules stood out.
sentences.zh: 其中一个分子脱颖而出。

sentences.en: Pretty quickly, the company's scientists identified this newer version as having potential in its own right.
sentences.zh: 公司科学家很快就认定这个新版本本身就具有潜力。

sentences.en: Maybe it should be developed on its own merits as a new potential blockbuster in the drug company's pipeline.
sentences.zh: 也许它应该凭借自身的优势被开发出来，成为制药公司产品线中潜在的重磅炸弹。

sentences.en: And I assume this is the version of the drug that the lawsuit talks about, right?
sentences.zh: 我猜这就是诉讼中提到的那个药物版本，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what was so exciting about this new version?
sentences.zh: 那么这个新版本有什么令人兴奋的地方呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So early studies conducted in animals and in the laboratory indicated that this new formulation was much better than the original version at delivering tenofovir to the cells in
sentences.zh: 早期在动物和实验室中进行的研究表明，这种新配方在将替诺福韦输送到体内目标细胞方面，

sentences.en: the body it was targeting.
sentences.zh: 比原始版本好得多。

sentences.en: And that meant that way less of it was leaking into the bloodstream, where it would travel to kidneys and bones and cause this toxicity.
sentences.zh: 这意味着进入血液循环的药物量大大减少，从而避免了它流向肾脏和骨骼并引起毒性。

sentences.en: And the early studies showed also that it could be given at a lower dose.
sentences.zh: 早期研究还表明，它可以以更低的剂量给药。

sentences.en: Now, it's important to say the Gilead scientists did not have definitive proof at this point that the newer formulation of the drug was safer in humans.
sentences.zh: 现在必须说明的是，吉利德的科学家当时并没有确凿的证据证明该药物的新配方在人体中更安全。

sentences.en: You would have to run bigger clinical trials to know for sure.
sentences.zh: 你需要进行更大规模的临床试验才能确定。

sentences.en: But there was some pretty strong early evidence that this was promising.
sentences.zh: 但有一些相当有力的早期证据表明它很有前景。

sentences.en: That was echoed in an internal memo from 2002 that said the newer version, quote, may translate into a better side effect profile and less drug-related toxicity, end quote.
sentences.zh: 2002年的一份内部备忘录对此进行了呼应，称新版本“可能会转化为更好的副作用特征和更少的药物相关毒性”。

sentences.en: That's huge, right?
sentences.zh: 这太重要了，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, that would mean that this new formulation was likely not to cause those awful side effects we heard David and so many others had.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这意味着这种新配方很可能不会引起我们听说大卫和其他许多人所遭受的那种可怕的副作用。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So at the time, there was a lot of optimism within the company about this newer version.
sentences.zh: 所以当时公司内部对这个新版本非常乐观。

sentences.en: It appeared to be full steam ahead with this drug.
sentences.zh: 该药物的研发似乎全速前进。

sentences.en: Company scientists were updating the research community at conferences.
sentences.zh: 公司科学家在会议上向研究界通报最新进展。

sentences.en: Executives were keeping investors abreaSt. The company was running projections looking at how much money the drug could make.
sentences.zh: 高管们让投资者随时了解情况。公司正在进行预测，评估该药物能赚多少钱。

sentences.en: And in 2002, the company began the first human clinical trial of the newer version to evaluate its safety.
sentences.zh: 2002年，公司开始了新版本的第一项人体临床试验，以评估其安全性。

sentences.en: In that same year, you can see in the documents that a Gilead employee mapped out a development timeline for the newer version.
sentences.zh: 在同一年，你可以从文件中看到，一名吉利德员工为新版本制定了开发时间表。

sentences.en: And the timeline projected that the company could get the newer version to market as quickly as 2006.
sentences.zh: 该时间表预计公司最早可以在2006年将新版本推向市场。

sentences.en: So that would have been just a few years after David had started on the old version of the drug.
sentences.zh: 那距离大卫开始服用旧版药物才过了几年。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: But that's not what ended up happening.
sentences.zh: 但最终发生的情况并非如此。

sentences.en: Even though there had been all this excitement among Gilead scientists about the newer version of the
sentences.zh: 尽管吉利德的科学家们对该药物的新版本感到非常兴奋，

sentences.en: drug, at some point around 2003, company executives started to sour on rushing it to market.
sentences.zh: 但在2003年左右的某个时候，公司高管开始对急于将其推向市场感到反感。

sentences.en: And Gilead did not follow through on those plans that could have brought it to market by around 2006.
sentences.zh: 吉利德并没有执行那些本可以在2006年左右将其推向市场的计划。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: So these internal documents indicate that executives started to worry that releasing the newer version
sentences.zh: 这些内部文件表明，高管们开始担心发布该药物的新版本

sentences.en: of the drug would eat into the market share for the older version of the drug.
sentences.zh: 会蚕食旧版药物的市场份额。

sentences.en: Now, the phrase they used was cannibalize.
sentences.zh: 他们当时使用的词是“蚕食”。

sentences.en: As in, the new drug would, quote, ultimately cannibalize, end quote, the market for the older drug.
sentences.zh: 即新药会“最终蚕食”旧药的市场。

sentences.en: Gilead would essentially be competing with itself.
sentences.zh: 吉利德本质上是在与自己竞争。

sentences.en: So that's pretty explicit.
sentences.zh: 所以这表达得相当明确。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And remember, Gilead at this time knew it had a monopoly on selling the older version of the drug that would last until 2017.
sentences.zh: 请记住，吉利德当时知道它对旧版药物的销售拥有垄断权，该垄断权将持续到2017年。

sentences.en: So there was still a lot of runway, still a lot of time for Gilead to earn money from this franchise.
sentences.zh: 所以吉利德还有很大的空间，还有很多时间从这个系列产品中赚钱。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is a rare golden ticket.
sentences.zh: 这是一张罕见的金奖券。

sentences.en: They want to keep it as long as it'll go.
sentences.zh: 他们想尽可能长久地保持下去。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So instead of pushing forward on this newer version of the drug, the documents indicate that the company was formulating a plan.
sentences.zh: 因此，文件显示，公司没有推进这个新版本，而是在制定一项计划。

sentences.en: It was called a patent extension strategy.
sentences.zh: 这被称为“专利延期策略”。

sentences.en: And it's repeatedly referred to that way in the documents.
sentences.zh: 在文件中多次以这种方式提及。

sentences.en: What the company wanted to do was find a way to maintain its monopoly, to maintain sales beyond the expiration of the monopoly on the first drug.
sentences.zh: 公司想要做的是找到一种方法来维持其垄断地位，在第一种药物的垄断到期后继续维持销售。

sentences.en: And the internal documents from 2003 showed that the company ultimately planned to time the release
sentences.zh: 2003年的内部文件显示，公司最终计划将新版药物的发布时间定在

sentences.en: of the newer version of the drug right when it would be optimal to switch patients over from the older drug.
sentences.zh: 将患者从旧药切换到新药的最佳时机。

sentences.en: This is right before the patent was expiring.
sentences.zh: 这就在专利即将到期之前。

sentences.en: One memo says the development of the newer version, quote, is timed such that it is launched in 2015, end quote.
sentences.zh: 一份备忘录称，新版本的开发“时间安排在2015年推出”。

sentences.en: Now to step back, you know, a drug like that isn't going to take 12 years to develop.
sentences.zh: 退一步说，你知道，像这样的药物开发不需要12年。

sentences.en: So this is a business analyst at the company proposing delaying the release of the newer version.
sentences.zh: 所以这是公司的一位商业分析师提议推迟发布新版本。

sentences.en: And so in 2004, Gilead halted the development of the newer version of the drug.

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So to recap, these documents suggest that company executives didn't want to squander any of this precious patent.

sentences.en: They wanted to be able to keep prices high for as long as possible to maximize profits.
sentences.zh: 他们希望尽可能长时间地保持高价，以实现利润最大化。

sentences.en: And so they halted the development of a new, potentially better drug, which is really the opposite of what the whole patent system is meant to do.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们停止了一种可能更好的新药的开发，这实际上与整个专利体系的初衷背道而驰。

sentences.en: That's the allegation.

sentences.en: Now, the documents don't explicitly say that the reason for halting development was because the company was following any sort of strategy to try to maximize profits.

sentences.en: But the documents do provide context around the business considerations Gilead was thinking about at the time.
sentences.zh: 但这些文件确实提供了吉利德当时考虑的商业背景。

sentences.en: And the plaintiffs say that the way the chronology ultimately played out, the way things ended up unfolding, validates their accusation.
sentences.zh: 原告方表示，最终发生的时间顺序，即事情最终的发展方式，证实了他们的指控。

sentences.en: What we know is that the newer version of the drug sat on a shelf for years, despite those early signs that it might turn out to be safer for some patients.
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，尽管有早期迹象表明它可能对某些患者更安全，但该药物的新版本还是被搁置了多年。

sentences.en: Gilead kept selling the older version.
sentences.zh: 吉利德继续销售旧版本。

sentences.en: It became a blockbuster, bringing in billions of dollars and keeping millions of patients alive.
sentences.zh: 它成为了一个重磅炸弹，带来了数十亿美元的收入，并让数百万患者得以存活。

sentences.en: And then in 2010, Gilead decided to resurrect the newer version of the drug.
sentences.zh: 然后在2010年，吉利德决定重启该药物的新版本。

sentences.en: They did the clinical trials, they went through the regulatory process, and they released it in 2015.
sentences.zh: 他们进行了临床试验，走完了监管流程，并于2015年发布了它。

sentences.en: So they followed through on their plan to extend the patent, the one they talked about in the documents.
sentences.zh: 所以他们执行了他们在文件中讨论的延长专利的计划。

sentences.en: It appears that way.
sentences.zh: 看起来确实如此。

sentences.en: Now, Gilead said this had nothing to do with following through on any sort of patent extension strategy.
sentences.zh: 现在，吉利德表示这与执行任何形式的专利延期策略无关。

sentences.en: They said the reason they changed their mind about whether the newer drug made sense to move forward with is that the situation for patients had changed by then.
sentences.zh: 他们说，他们改变对是否推进新药的看法的原因是，当时患者的情况已经发生了变化。

sentences.en: One consideration was that long-term HIV survivors were getting older.

sentences.en: They were more susceptible to bone and kidney probleMs.

sentences.en: And it made sense to have a safer option for them.
sentences.zh: 因此，为他们提供一种更安全的选择是有道理的。

sentences.en: And when the newer version came out, Gilead positioned it as just as effective as Truvada, but gentler on the bones and kidneys.
sentences.zh: 当新版本问世时，吉利德将其定位为与舒发泰（Truvada）同样有效，但对骨骼和肾脏的副作用更小。

sentences.en: In other words, it doesn't have the same side effects David suffered from.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，它不会产生大卫所遭受的那种副作用。

sentences.en: So when the patent on the older version expired in 2017, and drug makers offering generic versions were able to come in with their own products,
sentences.zh: 所以，当旧版本的专利在2017年到期，且提供仿制药的药企能够带着自己的产品进入市场时，

sentences.en: the price of Truvada ultimately went way down, from about $22,000 a year to under $400 a year.
sentences.zh: 舒发泰的价格最终大幅下降，从每年约22000美元降至每年不到400美元。

sentences.en: But Gilead successfully switched a lot of patients from the older version to the newer version.
sentences.zh: 但吉利德成功地将许多患者从旧版本切换到了新版本。

sentences.en: And those patients are still exposed to the higher price.
sentences.zh: 而这些患者仍然在承受着高昂的价格。

sentences.en: That's a sticker price of $26,000 a year.
sentences.zh: 那可是每年26000美元的标价。

sentences.en: And the switch to the newer version was really, really successful.
sentences.zh: 而且这种向新版本的切换确实非常、非常成功。

sentences.en: Today, Gilead drugs containing the newer version account for half the market for HIV treatment and prevention.
sentences.zh: 如今，吉利德含有新版本药物成分的产品占据了艾滋病治疗和预防市场的一半份额。

sentences.en: And it makes sense that people switched over, right?
sentences.zh: 人们选择切换到新药也是合情合理的，对吧？

sentences.en: Because this new version of the drug has fewer side effects.
sentences.zh: 因为这个新版本的药物副作用更少。

sentences.en: Well, it's a little more complicated, actually.
sentences.zh: 嗯，实际上情况要复杂一些。

sentences.en: The newer version doesn't have the old side effects, but it does have its own side effects.
sentences.zh: 新版本虽然没有旧版本的那些副作用，但它本身也有副作用。

sentences.en: It can cause weight gain and elevated cholesterol levels in some patients.
sentences.zh: 它会导致一些患者体重增加和胆固醇水平升高。

sentences.en: So I think the reality is that the older version is safer for some patients and the newer version is safer for other patients.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为事实是，旧版本对某些患者更安全，而新版本对另一些患者更安全。

sentences.en: But the lawyers in David's case say that if both versions of the drug had been available on the market, at least patients and their doctors would have had the
sentences.zh: 但大卫案的律师表示，如果市场上同时提供这两种版本的药物，至少患者和他们的医生会有

sentences.en: option to choose which version would best suit their needs based on those risks.
sentences.zh: 选择权，可以根据这些风险来决定哪种版本最适合他们的需求。

sentences.en: So you might switch patients who were experiencing kidney and bone issues over to the newer version.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以把那些出现肾脏和骨骼问题的患者切换到新版本。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So whatever the motive, what happened in the end was that the company did make enormous profits because the release of the new drug ended up being perfectly timed, right?
sentences.zh: 那么无论动机如何，最终发生的事情是，该公司确实赚取了巨额利润，因为新药的发布时间点恰到好处，对吧？

sentences.en: So how common is this?
sentences.zh: 那么这种情况有多普遍呢？

sentences.en: Like, is this a strategy that you see a lot in the pharmaceutical industry?
sentences.zh: 这在制药行业是一种常见的策略吗？

sentences.en: So under the current system, there are a ton of complicated ways that companies essentially extend their monopolies and maximize their profits.
sentences.zh: 在当前的体制下，公司有无数种复杂的方法来实质性地延长垄断并实现利润最大化。

sentences.en: So the phenomenon that we saw play out with Gilead's versions of tenofovir is called product hopping.
sentences.zh: 我们所看到的吉利德替诺福韦版本更替的现象被称为“产品跳跃”。

sentences.en: And that's because you're hopping patients from the older version of the drug over to the newer version of the drug just before the patent for the older drug runs out.
sentences.zh: 这是因为你在旧药专利到期前，就将患者从旧版本药物“跳”到了新版本药物上。

sentences.en: But there are other common strategies too.
sentences.zh: 但还有其他常见的策略。

sentences.en: One is called patent thicketing.
sentences.zh: 其中之一被称为“专利丛林”。

sentences.en: Patent thicketing?
sentences.zh: 专利丛林？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The idea here is to file so many patents on all sorts of things.
sentences.zh: 其核心思路是针对各种事物申请大量的专利。

sentences.en: The dosage, the delivery method, even things like a safety program to ensure that the drug is safely distributed.
sentences.zh: 剂量、给药方式，甚至像确保药物安全分发的安全计划这类东西。

sentences.en: And the idea is to make it as hard as possible for generic competitors to find their way through, like a thicket.
sentences.zh: 其目的是让仿制药竞争对手尽可能难以找到突破口，就像穿过一片丛林一样。

sentences.en: It's hard to navigate a thicket.
sentences.zh: 穿过丛林是很困难的。

sentences.en: Like a thick, an actual thicket of patents.
sentences.zh: 就像一片茂密的、真正的专利丛林。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The idea is that it's so costly, so time consuming for a smaller company to wade through that thicket of patents that they might give up.
sentences.zh: 其想法是，对于一家规模较小的公司来说，穿过那片专利丛林既昂贵又耗时，以至于他们可能会放弃。

sentences.en: They might decide it's too risky that they would face lawsuit or not be able to keep the product on the market.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会认为面临诉讼或无法让产品留在市场上的风险太大。

sentences.en: And companies do all sorts of things to try to fight off generic competition.
sentences.zh: 公司会采取各种手段来抵御仿制药的竞争。

sentences.en: They'll reach deals with generic competitors to minimize the impact of generic competition or sometimes sue them, claiming that companies are infringing on their patents.
sentences.zh: 他们会与仿制药竞争对手达成协议，以尽量减少仿制药竞争的影响，或者有时会起诉他们，声称这些公司侵犯了他们的专利。

sentences.en: So these strategies you're describing, they don't seem to have that much to do with creating new treatments.
sentences.zh: 所以你描述的这些策略，似乎与创造新的治疗方法没有太大关系。

sentences.en: They seem more about using pretty powerful legal and financial muscles to flood the zone in a way that blocks competition.
sentences.zh: 它们更多是利用强大的法律和财务手段来封锁领域，从而阻碍竞争。

sentences.en: But in the case of Gilead and Tenofovir, that meant not just blocking another company from entering the market, but actually hitting pause
sentences.zh: 但在吉利德和替诺福韦的案例中，这意味着不仅是阻止另一家公司进入市场，实际上是按下了暂停键，

sentences.en: on developing a new drug, their own drug, that could be less harmful.
sentences.zh: 推迟了开发一种可能危害更小的新药，也就是他们自己的药。

sentences.en: That feels ethically squishy.
sentences.zh: 这在道德上感觉很可疑。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There are definitely legal questions here, but there's also an ethical question.
sentences.zh: 这里肯定存在法律问题，但也存在道德问题。

sentences.en: Oftentimes when you see product hopping, there's not a ton of consequence about when the newer version is released.
sentences.zh: 通常当你看到“产品跳跃”时，关于新版本何时发布并没有太大的后果。

sentences.en: Oftentimes it's even criticized for being a tiny tweak, something that isn't important, something that doesn't improve outcomes, doesn't improve quality of life for patients.
sentences.zh: 它甚至经常被批评为只是微小的调整，无关紧要，既没有改善疗效，也没有提高患者的生活质量。

sentences.en: But I think what's distinctive about this case is the allegation that the timing of the release of the newer version of the drug resulted in harm to patients.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这个案例的独特之处在于，有人指控新药发布的时机导致了患者受到伤害。

sentences.en: The stakes here had an impact for patients' health.
sentences.zh: 这里涉及的利害关系影响到了患者的健康。

sentences.en: Not only for their pocketbooks.
sentences.zh: 而不仅仅是他们的钱包。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think that's one of the questions that's going to be addressed as the courts decide whether or not these lawsuits can move forward.
sentences.zh: 我认为这也是法院在决定这些诉讼能否继续进行时将要解决的问题之一。

sentences.en: But it seems like the argument, both in court but also ethically, rests on whether Gilead way back
sentences.zh: 但似乎无论是法庭上的辩论还是道德层面的讨论，都取决于吉利德在很久以前，

sentences.en: in the early 2000s actually knew that this newer drug would come out ahead when weighing the pros and cons.
sentences.zh: 也就是21世纪初，是否真的知道在权衡利弊后，这种新药会更胜一筹。

sentences.en: They had reason to believe it might turn out to be gentler on the bones and kidneys, but it was still really early days in the research.
sentences.zh: 他们有理由相信它最终可能对骨骼和肾脏更温和，但当时研究还处于非常早期的阶段。

sentences.en: So you could, at the time, reasonably conclude that the signal just wasn't strong enough for Gilead to have an ethical imperative to put the drug on a fast track.
sentences.zh: 所以，当时你可以合理地得出结论，认为证据信号还不足以让吉利德有道德义务去加速推进该药物的研发。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's really the question, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 是啊，这确实是问题的关键，不是吗？

sentences.en: How much evidence was enough evidence for Gilead to have a responsibility to move the drug forward?
sentences.zh: 究竟需要多少证据，吉利德才有责任推进该药物的研发？

sentences.en: So what kind of impact could a decision in this case have?
sentences.zh: 那么，此案的判决会产生什么样的影响呢？

sentences.en: So Gilead's lawyers say in legal filings that this could set a dangerous precedent, this argument that the plaintiff's lawyers are making.
sentences.zh: 吉利德的律师在法律文件中表示，原告律师提出的这一论点可能会开创一个危险的先例。

sentences.en: They are saying that if any company can be held liable for not releasing a product on a specific timetable, that could jeopardize innovation.
sentences.zh: 他们说，如果任何公司因为没有在特定的时间表内发布产品而承担责任，那可能会危及创新。

sentences.en: And the concern here is that if drug companies could be sued for not releasing products immediately, then they would
sentences.zh: 这里的担忧是，如果制药公司因为没有立即发布产品而被起诉，那么他们

sentences.en: be less likely to take the risk, spend huge amounts of money to run clinical trials if they could get in trouble, if they didn't get the timing just right.
sentences.zh: 就不太可能去冒险，也不太可能花费巨资进行临床试验，因为如果时间点没把握好，他们就可能惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, when you think about it, it is kind of strange, like a court ordering a company to release its product before it wants to.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当你仔细想想，法院命令一家公司在它自己想发布之前就发布产品，这确实有点奇怪。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: For instance, you probably wouldn't see Apple being held liable for not releasing its latest iPhone quickly enough.
sentences.zh: 例如，你可能不会看到苹果公司因为没有足够快地发布其最新款iPhone而被追究责任。

sentences.en: And I think there's precedent in past cases suggesting Gilead has a pretty strong defense here.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为过去的案例中有先例表明，吉利德在这里有相当强有力的辩护理由。

sentences.en: You know, when these sorts of patent strategies are challenged in court, drug companies often end up winning.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当这类专利策略在法庭上受到挑战时，制药公司往往最终会胜诉。

sentences.en: On the other hand, this isn't an iPhone.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，这并不是iPhone。

sentences.en: It's a drug, right?
sentences.zh: 这是一种药物，对吧？

sentences.en: Kind of different category.
sentences.zh: 属于不同的类别。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 吉利德的批评者认为，药物不能像其他产品那样对待，这是关乎生死的问题，而不仅仅是人们何时能用上最新版

sentences.en: the iPhone.
sentences.zh: iPhone的问题。

sentences.en: So is there a way to change the incentives for companies?
sentences.zh: 那么，有没有办法改变对公司的激励机制呢？

sentences.en: Well, one avenue is cases like David's, which could set a precedent for better or for worse, depending on your perspective.
sentences.zh: 嗯，一种途径是大卫这样的案件，它可能会开创一个先例，是好是坏取决于你的视角。

sentences.en: We'll see how that plays out in the courts.
sentences.zh: 我们将拭目以待法庭如何审理。

sentences.en: But as for policy changes, federal lawmakers regularly introduce bills that aim to crack down on various aspects of patent gaming.
sentences.zh: 但至于政策改革，联邦立法者经常提出旨在打击各种专利博弈行为的法案。

sentences.en: But those haven't gained much traction so far.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，这些法案还没有获得太大的推动力。

sentences.en: And there are lots of reasons for that.
sentences.zh: 原因有很多。

sentences.en: The industry lobbies hard against regulation.
sentences.zh: 制药行业极力游说反对监管。

sentences.en: But another consideration is that policymakers are worried about interfering with the system that we have set up.
sentences.zh: 但另一个考虑因素是，决策者担心干扰我们已经建立的体系。

sentences.en: The system that, in a lot of cases, has been extraordinarily successful at producing breakthrough therapies.
sentences.zh: 这个体系在很多情况下，在产生突破性疗法方面取得了非凡的成功。

sentences.en: And I think this is what is so hard about regulating the pharmaceutical industry.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是监管制药行业如此困难的原因。

sentences.en: We want to strike a balance between the benefits the system brings and the ways that it can sometimes harm patients.
sentences.zh: 我们希望在体系带来的好处与它有时可能伤害患者的方式之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: You know, we don't want to create incentives that discourage companies from coming up with breakthrough therapies.

sentences.en: We want to create the space where companies will take the risks to bring the next ruvada to market.

sentences.en: But we also don't want to have a system where companies prioritize profits over patients, where safer medications get delayed for business reasons and patients suffer.
